newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair says holds fares, eyes fuel prices.
newsitem.headline: Finnair says holds fares, eyes fuel prices.

text.p: Finnish airline Finnair Oy does not plan to increase its fares despite sharply higher jetfuel prices, a Finnair spokesman said on Wednesday.
"We have of course the same pressures as others but we are not at this stage planning to raise our fares," Finnair spokesman Usko Maatta told Reuters by telephone.
"We are now following the situation ... let's see where (prices) end up and stabilise," he said.
Asked whether this put pressure on profits -- which Finnair has already warned will be weaker in the financial year ending March 31 1997 than in the year before -- he said "we'll see".
